Leadership

Leadership rooted
in service.

Meet the Custos Rotulorum of Hanover and the elected officers serving the Hanover Justices of the Peace Association.

Official swearing-in photograph • Jamaica Information Service
Custos Rotulorum of Hanover

The Honourable Lennox Wayne Anderson-Jackson, JP

Appointed 4 April 2025Installed in Hanover 17 July 2025

A native of Hanover, the Honourable Lennox Wayne Anderson-Jackson, JP serves as the Governor-General’s representative and first citizen of the parish. He received the Instrument of Office at King’s House on 4 April 2025 and was formally installed at Rusea’s High School in Lucea on 17 July 2025.

A businessman, medical imaging practitioner and counselling psychologist, Custos Anderson-Jackson has pledged to lead with fairness, integrity and action. His responsibilities include guiding Hanover’s Justices of the Peace, supporting the appointment and swearing-in of new JPs, promoting civic pride and strengthening community service across the parish.

Sources: Jamaica Information Service • Ministry of Justice & Constitutional Affairs • Jamaica Gleaner

JP Services

What a Justice of
the Peace can do.

Justices of the Peace provide important voluntary services to individuals, communities and the justice system across Jamaica.

✍

Witnessing Documents

Witness signatures and execute document-related functions where Jamaican law permits.

✓

Certified Copies

Certify copies and attest documents where the relevant law or process allows a JP to do so.

§

Affidavits & Oaths

Administer oaths or affirmations and perform the JP role associated with affidavits.

▤

Statutory Declarations

Witness and administer statutory or voluntary declarations in accordance with the applicable requirements.

⚖

Bail Functions

Perform specified bail functions where the Bail Act authorises a JP to act as a deciding official.

⌁

Summonses & Warrants

Exercise authorised functions relating to informations, summonses and certain warrants within the law.

◉

Identification Parades

Observe identification-parade procedures and help safeguard fairness in the process.

⌂

Police Lock-up Visits

Participate in authorised visiting arrangements to monitor custody conditions and detainee welfare.

JP powers vary by function and must be exercised within Jamaican law.
Become a JP

A calling to
public service.

Appointment as a Justice of the Peace is based on integrity, community standing, service and successful completion of the required process.

Appointment pathway

How the process works

A Justice of the Peace is a voluntary public officer expected to demonstrate integrity, public trust and meaningful community service.

1Complete the prescribed application and submit it to the Custos for the parish where you live or work.
2Background review and consideration by the parish JP Advisory Committee.
3Complete qualifying training through the Justice Training Institute.
4Successful candidates proceed through recommendation and formal appointment.

Application guidance: Ministry of Justice & Constitutional Affairs, from the supplied official page. Submit the completed application to your parish Custos. The Ministry’s PDF service was unavailable when checked on 11 September 2026.

🇯🇲
Citizenship & residenceJamaican citizen and resident in Jamaica at appointment.

For serving Justices of the Peace

Your year of service.
Your annual report.

The Ministry’s guidance asks JPs to report to their Custos at the end of the calendar year. Use the official online form or the prescribed printable form.

Complete online

JP Annual Report

Complete and submit your report through the Ministry’s Microsoft form. Follow the instructions in the form for the reporting year and required details.

Open official form ↗

Your responses go directly to the official form service. HJPA does not collect or store your entries.

Paper option

Annual report schedule

View the Second Schedule in the supplied JP Act, PDF page 24. Print that page and follow your Custos’s submission instructions.

This supplied Act copy is available on HJPA. Opening or downloading it does not submit a report. The separate MOJ PDF could not be verified.

If the form does not appear, open it directly. Opening it elsewhere may not preserve unsent entries.

Open official form ↗

Source: Ministry of Justice & Constitutional Affairs — Justice of the Peace page supplied to HJPA. Form availability and submission instructions are managed by the Ministry.
